== Summary ==
“What changed on the image” comparison for [[Blaster Rifle (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]: The printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Left: the previous version; right: this version.

Made from the wiki's own images of the two versions with Pillow (crop and scale only).

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution image of a Star Wars CCG card or errata slip (© Decipher Inc. / Players Committee, Star Wars © Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to identify and study the card's errata on this non-commercial fan wiki; no free equivalent exists.
